risks.title: Regulation and Cost Recovery
risks.score_rationale: TXNM's profitability depends on the ability of its utilities to recover costs through regulated rates and earn a fair return on invested capital. Without timely recovery of costs, including unamortized investments, liquidity and operating results could be negatively impacted. Regulators may not authorize full cost recovery.

risks.title: Environmental and Climate Compliance
risks.score_rationale: TXNM is subject to stringent environmental laws and regulations, particularly regarding greenhouse gas emissions reductions. Climate change creates significant compliance costs and risks of non-compliance. Energy transition regulations may negatively affect operations and require substantial investments.

risks.title: Competition and Alternative Technologies
risks.score_rationale: TXNM faces increasing competition from new technologies and market entrants, particularly in distributed generation and energy storage. Technological advances could render existing facilities less competitive and impact revenue models.

risks.title: Dependence on Regulatory Decisions
risks.score_rationale: TXNM is highly dependent on favorable regulatory decisions (NMPRC, PUCT, FERC) to maintain financial health. Adverse decisions on rate approvals, cost recovery mechanisms, or investment authorizations could significantly impact earnings and cash flows.

risks.title: Operational Risks and System Reliability
risks.score_rationale: TXNM is exposed to operational risks including equipment failures, accidents, human error, and extreme weather events. The increasing integration of intermittent resources creates uncertainty in load forecasting and system planning. These risks could affect service continuity and financial performance.

risks.title: Climate Change Impacts
risks.score_rationale: Climate change increases the frequency and severity of extreme weather events, impacting TXNM's operations. TXNM must invest in grid resilience, wildfire prevention, and infrastructure adaptation. Associated costs and operational risks represent significant threats to financial results.

risks.title: Plant Decommissioning and Environmental Liabilities
risks.score_rationale: TXNM faces significant costs related to decommissioning and site restoration of nuclear and fossil fuel facilities. Cost estimates may prove insufficient, leading to material overruns. Regulatory changes affecting shutdown timelines could also impact financial forecasts.
